top_signals.title: Keppel Agrees to Merge Telecom Firms M1 and Starhub
top_signals.summary: Asset manager Keppel Ltd. agreed to combine M1 Ltd. with Starhub Ltd. in an all-share deal, bringing together two of Singapore’s major telecommunications operators following months of talks.

top_signals.title: Japanese bonds rally across curve as domestic stocks surge
top_signals.summary: The benchmark 10-year yield led the moves, falling 7 basis points to 2.715%. Five-year debt fell 5.5 basis points to 2.125%.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
